resultText:
Committed. This task is backend/API-only, so no UI screenshots are needed.

<<<JSON
{ "summary": "Built the HTTP app factory (src/app.ts) with the POST /api/links route — body-size capping, URL/alias validation, 409 on taken alias including the check-then-insert race — plus the entry point (src/main.ts) and a reusable test server helper (test/helpers.ts) consumed by test/create.test.ts. All 12 new tests plus the full 25-test suite and typecheck pass.", "notes_for_reviewer": "test/helpers.ts's startTestServer briefly listens a throwaway server on port 0 to learn a free port, closes it, then immediately creates the real createApp server on that same port so baseUrl can be known before construction (createApp needs baseUrl up front per the task spec). There's a theoretical port-reuse race in that gap; it's the standard pattern for this kind of test helper and wasn't observed to flake across repeated runs, but worth a second look since later endpoint tasks (p1-redirect, p1-stats) will reuse this helper." }
